posts.title: The Runway Debut: Partnering with Paul Costelloe AW26
posts.summary: Highlighting our journey from the Borehamwood workshop to the runways of London Fashion Week at The Waldorf Hilton.

sections.body:
A milestone year for Silver & Elegant. We were immensely proud to serve as an official jewellery partner for the Paul Costelloe Autumn/Winter 2026 collection, which debuted during London Fashion Week inside the historical Waldorf Hilton.

Under the creative direction of William Costelloe, the collection highlighted architectural shapes and rich textures, establishing a perfect dialogue for our sculptural jewellery.

sections.quote: Bringing our geometric silver and bronze structures from the London home studio onto the high-fashion runway represents an incredible validation of our design language.

sections.body:
Curated carefully by stylist Borna Prikaski and the fashion house's design team, our golden bronze structures and handcrafted crystal drops made their runway debut, adding raw metallic elegance to the fluid, high-fashion silhouettes.

This runway collaboration served as a perfect test of our core philosophy: that sculptural jewellery is not merely an accessory, but wearable art that command space and commands attention. Seeing the play of the runway lights against the hand-hammered textures of our golden Crustacea drops highlighted the beautiful tension between raw organic strength and high-fashion refinement.

We extend our deep gratitude to the Paul Costelloe team for welcoming us into their creative sanctuary. We look forward to the next horizon in wearable architecture.
